caption:
Momo spends all day at the coffee machine, tamping shot after shot. By close, her wrists and forearms feel tight and her shoulders feel heavy.

Tamping is the same movement over and over, and pressing with a bent wrist makes the forearm muscles work harder. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, and it works well alongside stretching and good technique.

Hybi's 1-minute stretch: arm out, palm away, ease the fingers gently back, 20 seconds × 2 each side, each break. Stop if your fingers tingle.

Hands tingling at night or dropping cups is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio ☕
